<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
<CLT=cltMIND>A ton of insect specimens are on display...

<CLT=cltMIND>It covers the entire wall!
I really feel the obsession...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a bookcase here...
It's full of books about insects.

<CLT=cltMIND>Wow...
That...is an extraordinary amount of bug cages.

<CLT=cltMIND>...I don't want to see another bug for
a long time.
